environment.description: Same Ktor service on ECS Fargate behind ALB, but the ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a custom rule group with priority 1 that inspects URI query strings using a regex pattern set matching session-identifier-like parameters (regex: `[?&](sid|session_id|jsessionid|PHPSESSID|token)=`). The rule action is BLOCK with a 403 response. Additionally, the WebACL has the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 5 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode (not block). The custom rule uses a RegexPatternSet with scope REGIONAL and the match is performed on the QUERY_STRING field with TextTransformation URL_DECODE applied. Note: the managed rule AWSManagedRulesKnownBadInputsRuleSet is NOT included — only the custom regex rule and CommonRuleSet are active.

config.infrastructure: AWS ECS Fargate, ALB (internet-facing), WAFv2 WebACL associated
config.network: Public subnet, ALB security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
config.tls: ALB-terminated, HTTP between ALB and container
